summary_en: Takamatsu Machinery executed a fixed-price share repurchase on November 10, 2026, acquiring 448,300 shares (4.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 548 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, for a total of approximately 245.6 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 9, 2026, Takamatsu Machinery's Board of Directors decided to execute a portion of its authorized share repurchase program through a fixed-price acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange trading). The company acquired 448,300 shares of its common stock on November 10, 2026, at a fixed price of 548 yen per share, representing 4.1% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The total acquisition cost was approximately 245.6 million yen. The purchase was executed through a single off-exchange trade order placed at the opening of ToSTNeT-3 trading on November 10 at 8:45 a.m. and was valid only during that trading session. This execution is part of a broader authorization adopted on the same date, under which the company is permitted to repurchase up to 520,000 shares for a maximum total of 300 million yen during the period from November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027.
